lead.headline: No claim before 01:00; after it, Strange and the Jaguars are free
lead.deck: Lamar Jackson's ankle takes Andrews out of the tight-end queue. Barkley is 'likely out'. And Tuten, not Gordon, belongs in the slot you opened today.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Saquon Barkley is now reported 'likely out' for London, with a fuller update due Wednesday, and your tight-end slot is still empty because Darren Waller is on bye. You fixed two of the morning's three zeros at 11:09: Carnell Tate is in for Rashee Rice, and Barkley is benched. The back you put in his place is Ollie Gordon. The projection has Bhayshul Tuten 3.1 higher, 14.0 to 10.9, and that is the one lineup change today. Waivers process at 01:00 tonight and this is the last brief before they do. Put in no claim. You are 8th in an order that never resets, and what this roster needs is available an hour later for nothing. At tight end the order has changed since this morning. Mark Andrews was first as long as Lamar Jackson played; on Tuesday afternoon Jackson was given 'only an outside chance' and ESPN cut Andrews to 9.6. Brenton Strange is now first: eight targets and 95 yards last week on 87% of the snaps, and at 16.7% owned he should clear. Colston Loveland is second and T.J. Hockenson, whose big game came with Justin Jefferson out, is third. The seat is Waller's, and taking it bends two of this brief's own rules; the card says which. The same visit after 01:00 is the time to swap the Ravens' defence, down to 4.9 with the line now against them, for the Jaguars', who face an Eagles offence without Barkley, Bigsby, Smith or Goedert. Every waiver column tells you to claim Will Shipley tonight. He is Barkley's handcuff and projects below three backs you own. ESPN has you at 39% against Kings of the North as set; with the three moves you project about 118 to their 123.

players.caption: Waller: on bye, and the seat

cannotSee.label: Which tight ends will clear
cannotSee.body: Strange, Loveland and Hockenson are all on waivers until Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City. ESPN shows only your own claims, so I can't see who is ahead of you; you are 8th of ten. The card's order is the plan; who is left is Wednesday's fact.

cannotSee.label: Lamar Jackson
cannotSee.body: 'Only an outside chance' is one reporter's line on Tuesday afternoon; CBS's note the same day says day-to-day. He isn't ruled out. Wednesday's practice report is the first hard evidence, and it comes after this brief.

cannotSee.label: Medical results
cannotSee.body: No scan grade is public for Barkley or Rice. Barkley's fuller update is promised for Wednesday, after waivers process, and nobody has reported whether he travels to London on Friday.

cannotSee.label: The two rules the second card bends
cannotSee.body: Dropping Waller breaks the letter of the churn rule (his seat changed on 3 Oct) and of the open-thesis rule (neither clause has tripped). I read a bye at a one-man position as the same thing as a ruling-out for this week. That is my interpretation, not the runbook's words.

cannotSee.label: Jaguars or Cowboys
cannotSee.body: ESPN projects Dallas 0.7 above Jacksonville and I have recommended Jacksonville anyway, on Philadelphia's injury list and two rankings. That is a judgement on a coin flip. I made two searches on the Dallas game and neither returned a usable preview.

cannotSee.label: Intraday projection moves
cannotSee.body: Between this morning's file and this one ESPN moved Kamara from 10.0 to 11.2, Shipley from 7.8 to 10.3, Andrews from 10.4 to 9.6 and the Ravens from 5.6 to 4.9. The last three have news behind them. Kamara's does not, as far as I found.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: Tiles now use FootballDB's full-PPR table, four games deep. It differs most from the standard table on Jacksonville against backs (7th or 2nd) and Chicago against receivers (5th or 9th).

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: Kendre Miller, Isaiah Williams, Antonio Williams, Oronde Gadsden and Tyler Higbee aren't on the published wire, so their availability here is the screen's inference.

cannotSee.label: Reports I couldn't retrieve
cannotSee.body: ESPN's article, injury and depth-chart pages returned empty, so I can't see why its labels on Jefferson and McLaurin changed. Star Tribune, Hogs Haven, Bleeding Green Nation, Stampede Blue, Arrowhead Pride, Field Gulls and Pro Football Rumors were blocked; RotoBaller and several NBC Sports pages gave no article body; FantasyPros' tables did not render. Kellen Moore, Kevin O'Connell, Dan Quinn and Jeff Hafley said nothing on Tuesday that I could find; the newest coach comments are Monday's. Pages were read through a summarising tool, so quotes are close but may not be exact. A Yahoo live-blog headline says Lane Johnson has announced his retirement; the article would not open and the Inquirer lists him only as sidelined.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Barkley and Rice have no scan grades and Team 13's Lamar Jackson is hurt; nothing can be priced.

cannotSee.label: Josh Jacobs
cannotSee.body: Still on the commissioner's exempt list, with no ruling in October; Heavy (6 Oct) says the league is waiting on video evidence. He projects 0.0.
